title: Tarkov’s 2020 streamed inventory: reporting Mono image and asset sizes
summary: A close look at the original game-specific module analysis: its three directories, mixed file/loaded-image size inputs and bounded send buffer establish a dated client report, not a universal integrity proof or present-day bypass.
author: Observatory editorial
takeaways: The article hypothesizes a Battlestate–BattlEye request but does not document that exchange.
This inventory reports filenames and sizes, not hashes of all loaded managed method bodies.
ASCII path handling and fixed report capacity are published code constraints, not a verified current evasion.

sections.title: Report content, limits and what remains unknown
